parties: Hero MotoCorp Limited (acquirer) | Euler Motors (target, associate company)
headline: Hero MotoCorp completes ₹210 cr investment in Euler Motors via Series E CCPS
sum: Hero MotoCorp has completed acquisition of 2,68,219 Series E Cumulative Compulsorily Convertible Preference Shares in associate Euler Motors for ₹210 crore, taking its stake to 36.67% (fully diluted). The investment was part of an announced ₹275 crore commitment (primary + secondary tranches) made on 5 February 2026.
implication: CCPS structures with compulsory conversion mechanics are common in growth-stage startup rounds; this deal illustrates how listed acquirers can scale associate holdings through staged preference share tranches while preserving governance control and downside protection-a structuring choice material under the Ind AS consolidated reporting regime and relevant to arm's-length pricing under transfer pricing rules.
detail: Hero MotoCorp, the Indian two-wheeler and three-wheeler OEM, acquired a Series E CCPS round in Euler Motors, its electric-vehicle technology associate, at a valuation point consistent with prior rounds. The ₹210 crore tranche brings Hero's fully diluted ownership to 36.67%, positioning it as a material minority holder with conversion rights. The parent Board had approved up to ₹275 crore in combined primary (new share issuance) and secondary (existing shareholder buys) form on 5 February 2026; this April 2026 completion of the ₹210 crore leg suggests selective tranching and negotiation of conversion terms. Euler Motors, founded 2018, is a electric commercial vehicle and battery technology startup; Hero's staged investment underscores the OEM's EV technology acquisition strategy ahead of ICE phase-out regulatory pressure in India.
